### workspace whereis --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace whereis

Print the workspace installation directory.

Examples:
  workspace whereis    # find out where a symlinked install really lives
  workspace whereis | xargs -I{} ls {}/lib/templates    # look at the project templates it ships
  workspace whereis | xargs -I{} git -C {} log -1 --oneline    # which commit this install runs
--- stderr
--- end
